verdict.rationale: Benchmark methodology transparency is a fair axis for a frontier model provider, but the evidence pack contains no published benchmark claims and no eval names, settings, harnesses or prompts from xAI. The docs cover API features, pricing, model specification cards and reasoning controls. Community comparisons are anecdotal user impressions, not vendor methodology.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them
